title: simpleObjects
body:
Adds objects to the Container Core Mod 'https://modrinth.com/mod/container-core', check the wiki 'https://github.com/dcqout/dcqinvcore/wiki' This mod is needed so the objects bellow can be used for containers creation inside resource packs, it works as an add-on, anyone can make their own objects that are used by container core. Current Objects: tooltip, takes: slot, tip, x, y, sizeX, sizeY, split_lines
label, takes: axis, centralized, font, title, x, y, color, has_shadow
entity_follow_mouse, takes: axis, startX, startY, endX, endY, back, size, entity
armor_stand, takes: axis, startX, startY, endX, endY, size, basePlate, arms, rotation, angleX, angleY, translationX, translationY, translationZ
smelt_animation(Only for furnace sprites), takes: axis, lit, progress, lit_x, lit_y, x, y More to come!
